en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over the rooftops of a town toward a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall square towers. Vegetation frames the foreground, while the city and distant landscape stretch into the haze. The caption at the bottom front identifies the view and city in Hungarian. The reverse side is an unused divided‑back postcard printed in Hungarian, with space for address and stamp and a small printer's mark from Budapest.
